_probe: CR-1d: Recovery pair — G-4(i) URL state + G-4(ii) public endpoint — 2026-07-25

g4i_url_state_preservation.implementation: On mount, reads ?exp=<id>&slot=<id> query params. Restores experience + slot selection after login redirect. State is preserved through the login redirect by appending ?exp=&slot= to the login URL.
g4i_url_state_preservation.key_code: const expParam = selected ? `&exp=${selected.id}` : ''; const slotParam = selectedSlot ? `&slot=${selectedSlot.id}` : '';

g4ii_public_endpoint.pii_gate: Returns: id, reference, status, paymentStatus, guestCount, totalAmount, currency, createdAt, slot.startTime, slot.endTime, experience.name, experience.city, experience.coverImageUrl
g4ii_public_endpoint.pii_withheld: guestName, guestEmail, guestPhone, meetingDetails, guestUserId, paystackRef
